# Terms of Service

**Last Updated: July 28, 2026**

Welcome to the services provided by CE Labs, LLC ("CE Labs," "we," "us," or "our"). Our website at [https://www.codex-everywhere.com](https://www.codex-everywhere.com) (the "Site") and related APIs, tools, and services (collectively, the "Service") provide developers with unified access to third-party AI model APIs, including models from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google (each, a "Model Provider").

By accessing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree, do not use the Service.

## 1. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years of age to use the Service. By using the Service, you represent that you meet this requirement and that your use complies with all applicable laws and regulations in your jurisdiction.

## 2. Account Registration

To use the Service, you must create an account and provide accurate, current information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and API keys, and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately at <email-redacted> if you suspect unauthorized access.

## 3. Service Description

CE Labs operates an AI API aggregation platform. We provide:

- Unified API access to multiple third-party AI models
- Usage tracking, monitoring, and analytics
- Account and subscription management
- Technical documentation and developer support

We may add, modify, or remove supported models or features at any time.

## 4. Payment and Credits

### 4.1 Pricing

Access to the Service requires the purchase of pre-paid credits ("Credits") or a subscription plan. Current pricing is displayed on the Site. We reserve the right to change pricing with reasonable advance notice.

### 4.2 Payment Methods

We accept payment via credit card, debit card, and other methods available through our payment processor, Stripe. Where available, we also accept Alipay and WeChat Pay. All payments are processed in U.S. dollars unless otherwise stated.

### 4.3 Refunds

Credits that have been consumed are non-refundable. If a paid service is not delivered as agreed, you may contact us within 14 days of payment to request a refund. Approved refunds will be returned to the original payment method. The following are generally non-refundable unless required by applicable law:

- API credits that have already been consumed
- Third-party model or vendor fees incurred on your behalf
- Platform or processing fees

### 4.4 Cancellation

Subscriptions may be cancelled at any time before the next billing date. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not refund usage fees already incurred. Unused Credits do not carry over between billing periods unless otherwise stated.

## 5. Acceptable Use

You agree to use the Service only for lawful purposes. You must also comply with each Model Provider's terms of service and acceptable use policies when accessing their models through our Service.

You may not:

- Violate any applicable law, regulation, or third-party right
- Use the Service to generate or distribute illegal, harmful, abusive, or infringing content
- Attempt to reverse engineer, scrape, or interfere with the Service or its security measures
- Resell, redistribute, or sublicense access to the Service without our written permission
- Circumvent usage limits, rate limits, or access restrictions
- Transmit malware, viruses, or other harmful code
- Misrepresent your identity or affiliation

Violation of these terms may result in immediate suspension or termination of your account.

## 6. Third-Party Model Providers

### 6.1 Model Terms

The Service provides access to AI models operated by third-party Model Providers. Each Model Provider has its own terms of service, acceptable use policies, and data practices. By using a model through our Service, you agree to comply with the applicable Model Provider's terms.

### 6.2 Availability

We do not guarantee the availability of any specific model. Models may be added, removed, or modified by their providers at any time. We are not liable for any changes, interruptions, or discontinuations by Model Providers.

### 6.3 Restricted Access

Certain Model Providers restrict access based on user location, entity type, or other criteria. You agree not to use the Service to circumvent such restrictions, including through VPNs or proxies. Any violation of this section is grounds for immediate termination.

## 7. User Content

### 7.1 Inputs and Outputs

You may provide inputs to the Service ("Inputs") and receive outputs generated by AI models ("Outputs," and together with Inputs, "User Content"). You retain ownership of your Inputs. Ownership of Outputs is subject to the applicable Model Provider's terms.

### 7.2 License to CE Labs

You grant CE Labs a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, store, and transmit your User Content solely as necessary to provide and improve the Service.

### 7.3 Responsibility

You are solely responsible for your Inputs and for evaluating the accuracy, legality, and appropriateness of any Outputs. AI-generated content may contain errors or inaccuracies. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or fitness for purpose of any Output.

## 8. Intellectual Property

The Service, including its design, code, documentation, and trademarks, is the property of CE Labs or its licensors and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws. These Terms do not grant you any rights to our intellectual property except the limited right to use the Service as described herein.

## 9. Privacy

Our collection and use of personal data is described in our [Privacy Policy](/privacy). By using the Service, you consent to our data practices as described therein.

## 10. Disclaimers

THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.

WE DO NOT WARRANT THAT THE SERVICE WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, ERROR-FREE, OR SECURE. WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ACCURACY OR QUALITY OF ANY OUTPUT GENERATED THROUGH THE SERVICE.

THE SERVICE DEPENDS ON THIRD-PARTY MODEL PROVIDERS. WE ARE NOT LIABLE FOR ANY INTERRUPTION, MODIFICATION, OR DISCONTINUATION OF THIRD-PARTY SERVICES.

## 11. Limitation of Liability

# Privacy Policy

**Last Updated: July 28, 2026**

CE Labs, LLC ("CE Labs," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website at [https://www.codex-everywhere.com](https://www.codex-everywhere.com) (the "Site") and use our AI API aggregation services (the "Service").

By accessing or using the Site or Service, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Site or Service.

## 1. Information We Collect

### 1.1 Information You Provide

When you register for an account or use the Service, we may collect:

- **Account information:** your email address, username, and password
- **Payment information:** billing details processed through our third-party payment processor (Stripe). We do not store your full credit card number on our servers.
- **Communications:** information you provide when you contact our support team or respond to surveys
- **User Content:** inputs you submit to AI models through the Service, and outputs generated in response

### 1.2 Information Collected Automatically

When you access the Site or Service, we automatically collect certain information, including:

- **Device and browser information:** IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type, and time zone
- **Usage data:** pages visited, features used, access times, referring URLs, and API usage patterns
- **Cookies and similar technologies:** we use cookies and similar tracking technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and analyze usage patterns. See Section 6 below.

### 1.3 Information from Third Parties

We may receive information about you from third-party services you use to sign in to the Service (such as Google), limited to the information you authorize those services to share.

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

- Provide, operate, and maintain the Service
- Process payments and manage your account
- Transmit your inputs to third-party AI Model Providers to generate outputs
- Communicate with you, including responding to support requests and sending service-related notices
- Monitor and analyze usage trends to improve the Service
- Detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and security issues
- Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service

We do not use your inputs or outputs to train our own AI models.

## 3. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

- **Model Providers:** When you use the Service, your inputs are transmitted to the third-party Model Provider you select. Each Model Provider has its own data practices, including whether they retain or use your data for model training. We encourage you to review each provider's terms before use.
- **Service Providers:** We share information with third-party vendors who assist us in operating the Service (e.g., payment processing, hosting, analytics), subject to confidentiality obligations.
- **Legal Requirements:** We may disclose your information if required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of CE Labs, our users, or the public.
- **Business Transfers:** In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction.
- **With Your Consent:** We may share your information for other purposes with your explicit consent.

## 4. Data Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. These include encryption, access controls, and secure server infrastructure.

However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is completely secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.

## 5. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. When your information is no longer needed, we will delete or anonymize it in accordance with applicable law.

You may request deletion of your account and associated personal data at any time by contacting us at <email-redacted>.

## 6. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use the following types of cookies:

- **Essential cookies:** required for the Site to function, such as session authentication and security cookies. These cannot be disabled.
- **Preference cookies:** remember your settings and preferences to personalize your experience.
- **Analytics cookies:** help us understand how visitors use the Site so we can improve it. We may use third-party analytics services such as Google Analytics.

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Site.

## 7. International Data Transfers

CE Labs is based in the United States. If you access the Service from outside the United States, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States. By using the Service, you consent to such transfers. Where required by applicable law, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers.

## 8. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information:

### 8.1 General Rights

- **Access:** Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
- **Correction:** Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information.
- **Deletion:** Request deletion of your personal information.
- **Objection:** Object to our processing of your personal information in certain circumstances.
- **Data Portability:** Request your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

### 8.2 California Residents (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you have the right to:

- Know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose
- Request deletion of your personal information
- Opt out of the sale of your personal information (we do not sell personal information)
- Non-discrimination for exercising your privacy rights

### 8.3 EEA and UK Residents (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, you have additional rights under the GDPR, including the right to withdraw consent at any time and the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

We process your personal data on the following legal bases: performance of a contract with you, your consent, compliance with legal obligations, and our legitimate interests in operating and improving the Service.

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at <email-redacted>.

## 9. Children's Privacy

The Service is not directed to individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn that we have collected personal information from a child, we will take steps to delete it promptly. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us.

## 10. Third-Party Links

The Site may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those third parties. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing them with any personal information.

## 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified via email or a prominent notice on the Site. Your continued use of the Service after such notice constitutes acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

## 12. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

**CE Labs, LLC**
Delaware, United States
Email: <email-redacted>

# Refund & Cancellation Policy

**Last Updated: July 28, 2026**

This policy explains how refunds and cancellations work for the services offered by CE Labs, LLC ("CE Labs," "we," "us," or "our"). It applies in addition to our [Terms of Service](/terms) and [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

## 1. Refund Policy

If a paid service is not delivered as agreed, please contact us within 14 days of payment. We will review your request and, if approved, issue a refund to the original payment method.

The following are generally non-refundable, unless required by applicable law:

- API credits that have already been consumed
- Third-party model or vendor fees incurred on your behalf
- Platform or processing fees that have already been charged by payment processors

If you experience a technical issue that prevents you from using credits you have purchased, please contact us promptly so we can investigate and resolve the issue.

## 2. Cancellation Policy

Subscriptions and recurring services may be cancelled at any time before the next billing date through your account settings or by contacting us. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not automatically refund usage fees already incurred during the current billing period.

Unused credits remaining in your account at the time of cancellation are subject to the terms under which they were purchased.

## 3. How to Request a Refund

To request a refund, contact us at <email-redacted> with:

- Your account email address
- The transaction date and amount
- A brief description of the issue

We aim to respond to all refund requests within 3 business days.

## 4. Disputes

If you are not satisfied with the outcome of a refund request, please contact us to discuss further. We are committed to resolving disputes in good faith.

## 5. Contact Us

For any refund or cancellation request, or questions about this policy, contact us:

**CE Labs, LLC**
Delaware, United States
Email: <email-redacted>
